info.title: Userplane Public API
info.description: Programmatic access to Userplane workspaces, recordings, and links. Authenticate with a Bearer token using your API key (uspl_ prefix).

bearerAuth.description: API key with uspl_ prefix. Create keys at dash.userplane.io/_/account?tab=developers
